# Stage 19: State-Weighted Defect Transfer

This stage proves that a positive state weight can transport the energetic
cost of rare boundary histories through a dependent block exploration.  It
strictly generalizes a scalar adaptive conditional ceiling for the connected
cluster events required by the rigidity basin.

The two-state calibration has scalar conditional ceiling one but weighted
ceiling `0.002430277501841998`, so its degree-18 rooted cluster budget is the
same subcritical budget as Stage 18.  This is a theorem about a declared
subkernel, not yet a construction of the complete nonlinear `SU(2)` kernel.

```bash
python3 -m unittest -v test_state_weighted_defect_transfer.py
python3 state_weighted_defect_transfer.py --output json
```
